user.title: Add a WebRelay-Quad
user.description: Enter the address of the relay board. Modbus must be available on it — see the errors below if it is not.

data_description.port: 502 unless it was changed on the device's Network setup page.
data_description.unit_id: 255, as the WebRelay-Quad's manual specifies. Leave this alone unless you have a reason not to.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Modbus device at that address. Check the address and port — and check that the device's control password is turned off. The WebRelay-Quad disables Modbus entirely whenever a control password is set, because Modbus has no way to carry one. You can have the control password or you can have this integration, not both.
error.not_a_webrelay_quad: Something answered at that address, but it is not a WebRelay-Quad. This integration writes to specific registers, so it will not continue against a device it does not recognise.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: That WebRelay-Quad is already set up.
